prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now so your newly adopted desktop pet is linked securely to your account and never lost.", "Sign In & Continue"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try out these essential pet controls to make sure your desktop companion is active and responsive.", "Start Playing", "Press Hotkey to Show/Hide Pet", "Right-click Pet for Action Menu", "Click & Drag Pet Across Desktop"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet & Workspace", "Your pet is being generated in the background. Step into the test sandbox while you wait!", "Open Placement Sandbox"]
3: ["Upload & Verify Pet Photo Quality", "We analyze your image in real-time to guarantee high-fidelity pet rendering on your desktop.", "Clear, well-lit photos work best for custom generation.", "Real-time Photo Analysis Preview", "Quality Check Passed"]
4: ["Your Companion is Almost Here!", "Feel free to use other apps. We'll chime and notify your desktop the moment your pet arrives.", "Completion Bell Cue"]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Existing Pets", "Already have an account? Sign in to immediately load your saved companions and sync adoption data.", "Your existing pet progress and inventory are safely stored in your cloud profile."]
6: ["This adoption record is linked to your account. Your companion stays saved even if you switch devices.", "Cloud Sync Protected"]
7: ["Claim Your Free Companion Accessory!", "Finish setup now to unlock an exclusive starter hat and toy for your new desktop pet.", "Claim Gift & Finish Setup", "Exclusive Starter Reward Unlocked"]
8: ["Choose Your Pet's Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to adopt a ready-made companion or design a custom pet from scratch.", "Standard Companion vs Custom Photo Pet"]
9: ["Crafting Your Custom Desktop Companion...", "Our engine is building your pet's 3D model, desktop collision physics, and unique personality traits.", "Rendering Graphics & Physics", "Tip: You can drag your pet anywhere on screen after spawn."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts, free extras, and exclusive rewards.
